text: Dual listing narrows bid ask spreads in traditional markets by injecting liquidity, but crypto markets behave differently: price differences between two exchanges can reach upwards of five percent during peak trading times.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Hayley Howe, Digital Asset Valuation (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4033886
abstract: For traditional markets, when a security is dual- listed, we see the bid-ask spread decrease because additional liquidity is being injected into the market. This differs from the crypto market where the difference between the two exchanges can reach upwards of 5% during peak trading times.5

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: assets listed on multiple crypto exchanges
